question:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

One who is all powerful.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e.** Omnipotent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Omnipotent"** means having unlimited power and able to do anything. (सर्वशक्तिमान)

 
 
• **Example:** Many religions describe their gods as omnipotent, capable of creating and destroying worlds.
 
 
 
• **"Omnipotent"** refers to someone who is all-powerful and has unlimited authority or influence. (सर्वशक्तिमान)
 
 
• **Example:** In mythology, Zeus is often depicted as an omnipotent deity who rules over the heavens and the earth.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the term for one who is all-powerful is **'Omnipotent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Omnipotent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Omnipresent** (सर्वव्यापी): Present everywhere at the same time.

 
 
• **Example:** The internet has become an omnipresent part of modern life.
 
 
 
• **Optimist** (आशावादी): A person who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the challenges, she remained an optimist, believing that things would improve.
 
 
 
• **Omniscient** (सर्वज्ञानी): Knowing everything.
 
 
• **Example:** In many stories, the narrator is omniscient, providing insights into the thoughts and feelings of all characters.
